author: Ifmyante
text:
I must vent my frustration, and what better place to do so than in my journal?

I started RTM for a number of reasons:

To help people become financially free

To make a group of traders who'll take over the World and give it to the people

The Blue Dot is also a part of this mission.

! had hoped that what I've done in RTM would inspire you to step out of
your comfort zone and help, in whatever way you can, to make this World a
 better place.

Only the tiniest percentage of you have been brave enough to get involved, and I take my hat off to you

The rest of you, however, have proven yourselves to be just takers.

As I see it, there are three types of person:

Takers

Givers

Sharers

The vast majority of the population seem to be takers. These people will
 forever make wonderful excuses to only look out for number one.

Then there are the givers. These poor people feel duty bound to actually take part in society.

I'd love to think there can actually be a type of person called a sharer. Someone who gives, but also gets.

But with the massive disparity between givers and takers, it seems unlikely that sharers can keep sharing without running dry!

Recently, I stated that maybe I should offer webinars and lessons as rewards for getting involved in the Blue Dot.

Since then I've had the most horrible experience:

Ono of our members is pestering me, saying that he's ready to start
bringing people to the Blue Dot once I assure him of the rewards he'll
get.

I started all this to be a part of a sharing community. Now, seeing how
little quid pro quo means to so many here, I think I'd be happy to close
 RTM to everybody but those who've proven themselves to be sharers.

To the sharers and givers reading this: You are the best people on this wonderful planet.

To the rest: Your excuses mean nothing

Have a great weekend everybody, and if you have a spare moment, ask
yourself if you're proud to hand this World to your children.

author: smimon
text:
Ifmyante wrote: I must vent my frustration, and what better place to do so than in my journal?

I started RTM for a number of reasons:

To help people become financially free

To make a group of traders who'll take over the World and give it to the people...

Just to add my opinion - I am truly thankful to you for everything
you've done in creating RTM, and sharing your ideas on here. I have no
idea how much longer it would have taken me to become skillful at
trading were it not for the materials on here which accelerated my
learning tremendously. My own journey is still not complete, but I have
all the tools I need to finish the rest of it on my own. As you've
stated, you've put more than enough material out there across this forum
 and others, that no further lessons or webinars should be required
anyway.

I've done what I can by sharing my learning process and insights in my
own journal, in the hope that others may be able to take something from
it. I'm currently part of a Skype group with a bunch of people from
these forums, where we all help each other out on a daily basis.

I respect you, what you've achieved, and that you have such a strong
vision - but I don't subscribe to your politcal philosphy however, and
for that reason don't want to get involved with the Blue Dot project.

In my experience, if you give the majority of people an opportunity to
take without giving anything back, they will. It's just human nature.
Exceptions exist of course, but generisations hold true, and wishing it
were not so won't change it unfortunately.

All the best to you with your project.

author: Ifmyante
text:
Thanks so much PPG

There IS something you can do!

Next time you want to watch a sports match or movie surf the web,
consider googling things like "money is debt", ""eugenics", "the
endocannabinoid system", "renewable energy", "sustainable living",
"false flags".

Paste links to everything you've learned on your social media, and share them in the Blue Dot.

You'll not only be fascinated with what you learn, but will be able to spread the word as you do so.

If enough people do this, it won't take a big time investment from each individual.

We desperately need to become educated about the massive fraud which is
robbing each of us of our happiness, so that we can at last take the
power back and share this planet among us all.

author: Ifmyante
text:
Smimon

I'm not looking for a group of sycophants!

I want people with every opinion to take part in the future.

If however, you disagree with me because you think everything is just
fine the way it is, I urge you even more strongly to get involved

author: smimon
text:
I do not think everything is fine the way it is, far from it. Suffice
 to say I believe that democracy, whatever form it takes, is an
inherently flawed system of government, and will always end up in a
gradual decline into tyranny. I'm actually a monarchist, for many
reasons. But this perhaps isn't the best place to get into a debate on
political philosphy

If you're at all interested in exporing another angle on ths issue, and
have some spare time, I strongly recommend giving the first few chapters
 of this book a read.

 www.riosmauricio.com/wp-content/uploads/..._God_That_Failed.pdf

This is also a fascinating read, and only a shorter essay.
 www.newworldeconomics.com/archives/2014/...esbySirJohnGlubb.pdf
